cases.title: GAPS · guitar performance 019
cases.description: Four aligned 20-second guitar conditions: original GAPS recording, Flat 64, 5 s Diff-Synth, and 5 s Diff-SFProxy.
cases.provenance: GAPS test piece 019_Vpswc from the 5090 HDF5 cache. Diff-Synth and Diff-SFProxy were rerun on its aligned score using adapted 5 s guitar VeloEst checkpoints recovered from the 5090 /storage HDD archives (60k and 120k iterations respectively). The original archived Diff-Synth prediction omits seven score notes across these two windows, so this demo uses a complete rerun from its recovered checkpoint. The score has no ground-truth guitar velocities, so no guitar MAE is shown. Both renders use FreePats Spanish Classical Guitar SFZ.

cases.title: François Leduc · guitar performance QDC4c
cases.description: Four aligned 20-second guitar conditions from the same François Leduc performance, with 5 s adapted models.
cases.provenance: Original François Leduc recording and aligned score from the 5090 HDF5 cache (QDC4c). Diff-Synth and Diff-SFProxy predictions were rerun over the full piece from the recovered 5 s guitar checkpoints (60k and 120k steps), keeping every score note aligned. These example-specific results are separate from the paper aggregates; the archived Diff-SFProxy checkpoint’s FL aggregate does not reproduce the paper-selected 0.777. All resynthesized clips use FreePats Spanish Classical Guitar SFZ. The aligned guitar score has no verified velocity labels, so no MAE is shown.

cases.title: Scriabin, Entragete · 2009 performance
cases.description: One matched 20-second piano excerpt with the original performance, a constant-velocity control, and both saved adaptation methods.
cases.provenance: 20-second Scriabin excerpt with 137 aligned notes. Diff-Synth is a saved 5 s, 60k prediction; Diff-SFProxy was rerun from the released piano 5 s, 120k checkpoint. Card scores are computed on this excerpt, separate from full-piece and paper aggregate metrics.

cases.title: Scriabin, Entragete · 2009 performance

cases.title: Bach BWV 849 · SMD piano performance

cases.provenance: MAE badges are computed over the selected 20 seconds (113 score notes), not the full SMD piece or the paper aggregate. Diff-Synth is the saved 5 s, 60k sup0/backend1 run; Diff-SFProxy is the saved 5 s, 120k smooth-L1 run. All renders use Salamander Grand Piano V3.
